name: Hela
title: Asher's Son and Patriarch of the Tribe
summary: Hela (also known as Hela or Helah) was one of the sons of Asher, Jacob's son, and became a patriarch in the tribe of Asher in Israel. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Genesis and 1 Chronicles as part of Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned Among the Sons of Asher
keyEvents.description: Hela is listed as one of the sons of Asher in the genealogy of Jacob's descendants who traveled to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Included in the Genealogies of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Hela is mentioned again in the detailed genealogy of Asher's descendants in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Part of the family that went to Egypt
keyEvents.description: As part of Jacob's extended family, Hela was among the seventy people who went down to Egypt to live with Joseph during the famine.

keyEvents.title: Asher's tribe blessed by Jacob
keyEvents.description: Jacob blessed Asher and his descendants, including Hela, with promises of rich food and royal delicacies.

keyEvents.title: Asher's tribe blessed by Moses
keyEvents.description: Moses blessed the tribe of Asher, to which Hela belonged, with promises of prosperity and strength.
